teamAnswer: Yes. The Business plan lets you manage unlimited members, assign roles, import CSV data and apply the same company design to every card.
expiryQuestion: What happens when my plan expires?
expiryAnswer: Your account moves to the Free plan and your card stays active. Renew to keep using Pro or Business features such as white labeling and campaigns.
cancelQuestion: Can I cancel at any time?
cancelAnswer: Yes. You can cancel your subscription at any time.
safetyAnswer: Your data is protected in line with the GDPR and stored in the EU.
